title: Exclude three and four simultaneous Type B phase transfers (0% κ change)
body:
## Change and scope

**NO VERIFIED GAIN. Exact conditional κ change 0%.** On exact signed #7113, all 10,400 triple and 14,950 quadruple Type B phase-transfer choices change the arbitrary-input endpoint at q = −1 and unit body. The modular reflection and independent exact rational causal-impulse checks agree on all 25,350 keys. Both exhaust the scope with zero survivors or unresolved cases.

The four singleton odd idles and 26 larger even idles are the only sites. All original clocks, roles, body masks and J blocks stay fixed. The entire four-transfer stock has gross upper 0.22541521474570153 raw before ancillary costs. One added paid rank-one position defeats that bound. The exact compatible saving is zero.
